overall: The AG found the Belmont Fire Chief Screening Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing interview questions, schedule, and process in its January 6 executive session, which Purpose 8 does not cover. No further remedial action was ordered because the minutes had already been released.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the screening committee improperly discussed interview questions in executive session on January 6 under Purpose 8.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law when it discussed interview questions, schedule, and process in executive session on January 6.
